_provenance.generated_by: Wavepacket dynamics in 1D Almost-Mathieu tight-binding model via eigendecomposition
_provenance.data_origin: Analytical: quasiperiodic Hamiltonian with golden-ratio frequency. Transport exponents from spectral theory.

_description: Wavepacket transport in 1D quasiperiodic (Almost-Mathieu) chain: ballistic for λ<2, localized for λ>2, anomalous at λ=2
_groundspring_question: When energy is injected at a single point in a noisy medium, does it propagate or stay trapped? The transport exponent β quantifies whether signal reaches the detector.
_cross_spring: hotSpring — spectral theory; wetSpring — nutrient transport in porous media (Anderson localization analog)

model._description: 1D tight-binding with quasiperiodic potential: H_{ij} = δ_{i,j±1} + λ cos(2παi + θ) δ_{ij}. Wavepacket ψ(0)=δ_{N/2} evolved under Schrödinger dynamics. MSD σ²(t) ~ t^{2β} extracts transport exponent β.

analytical_predictions._description: From spectral theory: purely AC spectrum for λ<2 → ballistic (β=1); purely PP spectrum for λ>2 → localized (β=0). At critical λ=2: singular continuous spectrum → anomalous transport (0<β<1).

expected_results.ballistic_beta_range_rationale: For lambda<2, purely AC spectrum gives beta=1 (ballistic); finite chain (N=201) and finite time (t=40) cause underestimation; 0.75 floor from power-law fit uncertainty.
expected_results.localized_beta_max_rationale: For lambda>2, purely PP spectrum gives beta=0 (localized); finite-time MSD residual growth gives apparent beta ~ 0.05-0.10; 0.15 provides 1.5x margin.
expected_results.critical_beta_range_rationale: At lambda=2, singular continuous spectrum gives anomalous transport 0<beta<1; exact beta depends on theta, chain length, and time range; wide range reflects genuine theoretical uncertainty.
expected_results.msd_localized_bounded_max_rationale: Localization length xi ~ 1/ln(lambda/2); for lambda=3, xi~0.85, so MSD saturates at ~xi^2 ~ 0.7; 25.0 provides margin for finite-time transient spreading.
expected_results.normalization_tolerance_rationale: Wavepacket normalization |psi|^2 = 1 preserved by unitary evolution; finite-precision eigendecomposition introduces O(machine epsilon) drift; 1e-10 is 1e5 * machine epsilon.
expected_results.lyapunov_extended_max_rationale: For lambda<2, gamma=0 analytically; transfer matrix computation with N=100000 sites gives gamma ~ O(1/N) numerical residual; 0.01 provides 100x margin.
expected_results.lyapunov_localized_min_rationale: For lambda=3, Herman formula gamma=ln(3/2)=0.405; for lambda=4, gamma=ln(2)=0.693; 0.2 floor is well below theoretical minimum at lambda=3.
